hero.subtitle: Whitehorse Foodtech connects sourcing, R&D and product development, quality management, and the right manufacturing partners to build ingredient solutions that are consistent, adaptable and ready for international markets.

origin.title: Our story
paragraphs: Vietnam is home to a rich, diverse range of agricultural raw materials. But turning a local ingredient into a product that meets the standards of international food and beverage brands takes more than a good source of supply.

The product has to be developed for the right application, controlled against clear specifications, produced consistently, and backed by documentation that matches the requirements of each destination market.

Whitehorse Foodtech exists to connect those pieces into a single, coordinated process. We bring together sourcing, R&D capability, quality management, the right manufacturing partners and export operations to turn the potential of Vietnamese ingredients into solutions that can be commercialized internationally.

Rather than starting from a fixed product, we start from what the customer actually needs: what application the product serves, what standards it has to meet, how it should be packaged, and what's required to enter the target market.
Whitehorse Foodtech was registered in Hanoi in August 2026. We are starting with coffee, and sourcing or developing other ingredients on request while our supplier network goes through qualification.

valueCreation.title: How we create value
valueCreation.subtitle: A good ingredient solution has to balance four things: the right source, a product built for its application, consistent quality, and the ability to commercialize it efficiently.

coffee.name: Coffee Ingredients
coffee.description: Coffee ingredients from Vietnam's main growing regions, coordinated for trading houses, ingredient distributors and beverage manufacturers. Formats we can discuss include green and roasted beans, roasted & ground coffee, instant coffee (spray-dried, agglomerated or freeze-dried) and cold brew, in bulk or private-label packaging. Availability depends on supplier qualification for your specification and market.
specs: Robusta: Screen 16/18, moisture 12.5% max, black & broken 3–5% max
Arabica: Screen 15+, moisture 12% max, fully washed or natural process
Processed formats: instant coffee (spray-dried, agglomerated or freeze-dried), coffee extract and concentrate, unsweetened cold brew concentrate — concentration agreed per order
Packaging: 60kg jute bags with GrainPro liner (green beans); jars, drums or bag-in-box for powder, extract and cold brew; single-serve sachets and retail boxes for private-label formats
Custom roasting, formulation and private-label packaging discussed per project

coconut.name: Coconut Ingredients
coconut.tagline: Milk, cream, water, powder, oil & MCT
coconut.description: Coconut ingredients sourced on request — milk and cream, powders, water concentrates, virgin coconut oil and MCT — matched to suppliers whose product, site and certifications fit your specification and market, in bulk or private-label packaging.
specs: Liquid formats: coconut milk (carton) and coconut cream (jar) at standard or custom fat content, UHT/aseptic packaging on request
Powder formats: coconut milk powder and coconut cream powder (plant-based, gluten-free, no added sugar), NFC coconut water, coconut water concentrate and coconut water powder
Oils & functional lipids: cold-pressed virgin coconut oil, unflavored MCT oil and MCT powder
Packaging: cartons, jars, stand-up pouches, aseptic bags, drums or bulk — format and packaging confirmed per order
OEM and private-label formulation discussed per project

birdsNest.name: Bird's Nest Ingredients
birdsNest.description: Vietnamese edible bird's nest developed on request into selected nest, concentrates, extracts, powders and customized formulations for nutrition and premium food applications, from bulk ingredients to private-label retail formats.
specs: Formats: selected raw and cleaned bird's nest, concentrate, pure extract and powder — bottled ready-to-drink formats on request
Custom formulation: sugar level, added ingredients (rock sugar, ginseng and other variants) and packaging configured to buyer requirements
Packaging: retail glass bottles (typically 70ml multi-packs) for RTD formats; jars or vacuum packs for selected/dried nest; gift box and private-label packaging on request
Shelf life and cold-chain requirements vary by format — confirmed with our team per order

fruit.name: Fruit Ingredients
fruit.description: Vietnamese tropical fruits sourced on request as freeze-dried powders and pieces, concentrates and extracts for food, beverage and nutrition applications, matched to suppliers whose processing fits your specification.
specs: Freeze-dried powders: passion fruit, mango, dragon fruit, durian, soursop, pineapple, banana, orange and other fruits on request — moisture 3–5% max, 80–100 mesh typical
Freeze-dried pieces: slices, cubes and crumbles for bakery, cereal and snack applications
Fruit concentrates: puree and juice concentrate for beverage and flavor applications
Extracts: natural fruit extract and fruit flavor base in dropper-bottle format for precise dosing
Packaging: aluminum foil bags with desiccant (1kg–25kg) or bulk drums for powders/pieces; glass bottles for concentrates and extracts — custom particle size and packaging on request

nutsSpicesBotanicals.name: Nuts, Spices & Botanicals
nutsSpicesBotanicals.tagline: Cashew, pepper, cinnamon, star anise & botanicals
nutsSpicesBotanicals.description: Vietnamese nuts, spices and botanicals sourced on request for international food manufacturers and ingredient partners, with specifications and documentation agreed per order.
specs: Nuts: cashew (WW240/WW320/SW240 grades, vacuum-packed 22.68kg tins) and macadamia, in-shell or kernel

Spices: black pepper (500–570 g/l density, moisture 13% max) and white pepper, cinnamon and star anise (whole, broken or ground, graded by oil content and moisture), chili — steam-sterilized on request
Botanicals: ginger, turmeric, lemongrass, pandan and other Vietnamese botanicals, fresh, dried or powdered on request
Packaging: retail jars and packs for private-label lines; bulk vacuum-packed tins, bags or drums for wholesale — format confirmed per order

privacyBody: What we collect: when you use our contact or quote-request forms, we collect the details you enter (such as your name, company, email, phone, destination and request details) and basic context such as the page you submitted from, your site language and any campaign (UTM) parameters in the link you followed.

How we use it: only to respond to your inquiry, prepare quotations and follow up on the commercial conversation you started. We do not sell your data. Submissions are delivered to our team by email and processed by our website hosting and email providers.
Your choices: to access, correct or delete your data, email {email}. Data controller: {legalName}, business registration no. {taxCode}, Hanoi, Vietnam.
termsBody: Website content, including product descriptions and specifications, is indicative and for information only. It is not an offer to sell and does not indicate that a product is in stock or export-ready.

Commercial terms — price, specification, quantity, payment, Incoterm, delivery, inspection and claims — are set out in each written quotation and sales contract, which take precedence over anything on this website.
